projects.description: The list of projects to fix dependencies for.

reset.description: Whether to reset the project's dependencies before fixing them.

resolve.description: Whether to resolve dependency versions from the workspace root 'package.json'.

resetAll.description: Whether to reset all project dependencies, including peer dependencies.

strict.description: Whether to fail if any required dependency cannot be found in the workspace.

onlyDependencies.description: Whether to move all peer dependencies to the regular dependencies section.

dependencies.description: A list of package names that should always be added to the 'dependencies' section.

peerDependencies.description: A list of package names that should always be added to the 'peerDependencies' section.
